seo.title: CueBooker | Booking management for DJs
seo.description: Receive complete requests, reply to promoters by email and control availability, calendar and history inside one booking.

hero.eyebrow: BOOKING MANAGEMENT FOR DJS AND AGENCIES
hero.body: Receive complete requests and manage conversations, terms, statuses and dates in one place, even when contact starts on Instagram, WhatsApp, email or a phone call.
proofs: Each booking keeps its conversation and status

problem.title: Too many channels. No shared state.
problem.body: A contact may start on Instagram, WhatsApp, email, a phone call or a website. CueBooker does not replace your contacts or promise to get you gigs: it organises what happens once someone wants to book you, so you know what to answer, what is pending and which date is confirmed.
problem.statement: Every contact needs a next action.

search.title: When a real network exists: discover available DJs.
search.body: As a future layer, CueBooker may connect the availability each artist chooses to show with searches by date, city, sound and budget. The core product will remain the management of requests DJs already receive.
search.resultHint: Concept demonstration. Budget filters matches, but each DJ's fee remains private. Artists and results are fictional.

flow.title: From the first request to the calendar. Without losing the thread.
flow.body: Every step stays inside the same booking. The promoter starts without an account, while the DJ keeps the details, conversation, status and date together until confirmation.

steps.name: Share
steps.detail: The DJ publishes a link on Instagram, WhatsApp or their website.

steps.name: Request
steps.detail: The promoter sends the date, venue, schedule and offer without signing up.

steps.name: Receive
steps.detail: CueBooker creates the booking and adds it to the DJ's inbox.

steps.name: Reply
steps.detail: The conversation and terms stay attached to the same record.

steps.name: Agree
steps.detail: Both sides review the offer and always know the next action.

steps.name: Confirm
steps.detail: The date changes status and is added to the calendar.

integrations.title: Your own link. A widget when you already have a website.
integrations.body: CueBooker sits wherever people already find you. The promoter opens the form, sends the details and continues the conversation from email.

items.label: NO WEBSITE
items.name: Instagram, Linktree and WhatsApp
items.body: Share a different URL for each channel. CueBooker identifies the source and brings every request into one inbox.

items.label: WITH A WEBSITE
items.name: Universal widget
items.body: Copy a small snippet into WordPress, WooCommerce, HTML, React, Angular or Vue. The form opens inside your website.

items.label: FOLLOW-UP
items.name: Connected email
items.body: The DJ replies from CueBooker. The promoter receives an email and returns to the same booking through a secure link.

integrations.note: The DJ configures the service from their workspace. The promoter installs nothing. An npm package would be a developer option, not the main product.

roles.title: Useful when you start. More useful as the work grows.

items.name: Independent DJ
items.headline: Your profile, availability and every enquiry.
items.body: Whether you receive three requests or thirty, share your link and turn scattered messages, calls and emails into bookings you can track without losing any.

items.name: Promoter or venue
items.headline: Ask without installing another tool.
items.body: Open the DJ link, send the details and continue from email or a secure page. An account becomes optional after repeated use.

items.name: Manager or agency
items.headline: Your roster stays under your control.
items.body: Register the agency, add artists and route each enquiry to the right person with private permissions, fees and calendars.

access.eyebrow: FRICTION ONLY WHEN IT ADDS VALUE
access.title: The DJ gets a workspace. The promoter only needs to reply.
access.body: DJs and agencies create their workspace. A promoter can send the first request without an account and receives secure access to continue the booking.
access.demoNote: DJs and agencies can now create an account, complete their initial profile and manage availability from a private workspace.

roles.name: PROMOTER
roles.label: ACCESS / PROMOTER

steps: Reply and confirm through a secure link

demo.title: What you can manage today. And what comes next.
demo.body: Create your account and enter your workspace to explore CueBooker's current flows. We include some sample data so you can understand the product from the first moment instead of starting with an empty inbox.
real: DJ discovery by date, city and sound
demo.realNote: Your workspace includes some sample data so you can explore CueBooker's flows from the first moment.

entry.title: Start managing your bookings.
entry.body: Create an account as a DJ or agency and set up your first profile and private calendar.

feedback.title: Help us build CueBooker around real workflows.
feedback.body: If you are a DJ, manager, agency, promoter or venue, leave your details to take part in testing and tell us how you manage bookings today.
feedback.note: This form is for product testing and feedback. To use your private workspace, create an account.

form.title: Take part in CueBooker testing
form.body: Tell us about your role. We will contact you to test features and collect feedback on your real workflow.
form.emailHelp: We will use your email to contact you about CueBooker testing.
form.consentText: I agree that CueBooker may use my details to contact me about testing and send project-related updates.
form.success: We have received your details. We will contact you about upcoming tests and feedback sessions.
form.invalid: The information is not valid. Check your email address and try again.
